docs.message:
docs: add a skill for reading the platform design from other repos

## Intent

The other repositories of the lernapps organisation need to know that the platform is designed with the Platform Design Toolkit, where that design lives and how to read it. They need only the entry points, not the next steps of the method.

## Key changes

- A compact skill says that lernapps.net is a platform in the sense of PDT and is read with a checkout plus `pdt42 get`. A table names the chapter of each element type: entities, platform, motivations, relationships, transactions, learning engine, experiences and MVP. It points to the key decisions on thanks and on data collection.
- The README lists the skill.

## Dependencies and side effects

- app-templates and tooling link the skill and the rendered design in their READMEs (f00a343, a29546b).
- The link to /docs/platform-design/ works once the branch is merged.

app-templates.message:
docs: point to the platform design

## Intent

This repo is part of the lernapps.net platform, whose design lives in lernapps/docs. People and agents working here should find it.

## Key changes

- One short README paragraph says how the repo relates to the platform design and links the rendered design and the pdt skill in lernapps/docs.

## Dependencies and side effects

- The skill comes from lernapps/docs (3654d5e); tooling has the same paragraph (a29546b).
